import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV, calibration_curve
from sklearn.isotonic import IsotonicRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings
import os
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

start_time = time.time()

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Create stratified validation split (20% hold-out) - fit models only on training data
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train.index, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train["author"]
)
train_fold = train.loc[train_idx].copy()
val_fold = train.loc[val_idx].copy()

# Word-level TF-IDF vectorizer (unigrams + bigrams + trigrams)
vectorizer_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=15000,
    min_df=2,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Character-level TF-IDF vectorizer
vectorizer_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(1, 4),
    max_features=15000,
    min_df=2,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Vectorize text
X_train_word = vectorizer_word.fit_transform(train_fold["text"])
X_val_word = vectorizer_word.transform(val_fold["text"])
X_test_word = vectorizer_word.transform(test["text"])

X_train_char = vectorizer_char.fit_transform(train_fold["text"])
X_val_char = vectorizer_char.transform(val_fold["text"])
X_test_char = vectorizer_char.transform(test["text"])

# Concatenate word and character features
X_train_tfidf = np.hstack([X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray()])
X_val_tfidf = np.hstack([X_val_word.toarray(), X_val_char.toarray()])
X_test_tfidf = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray()])

# Add document length features
train_fold["char_count"] = train_fold["text"].apply(lambda x: len(x))
train_fold["word_count"] = train_fold["text"].apply(lambda x: len(x.split()))
val_fold["char_count"] = val_fold["text"].apply(lambda x: len(x))
val_fold["word_count"] = val_fold["text"].apply(lambda x: len(x.split()))
test["char_count"] = test["text"].apply(lambda x: len(x))
test["word_count"] = test["text"].apply(lambda x: len(x.split()))

# Add vocabulary diversity feature
train_fold["vocab_diversity"] = train_fold["text"].apply(
    lambda x: len(set(x.split())) / len(x.split()) if len(x.split()) > 0 else 1.0
)
val_fold["vocab_diversity"] = val_fold["text"].apply(
    lambda x: len(set(x.split())) / len(x.split()) if len(x.split()) > 0 else 1.0
)
test["vocab_diversity"] = test["text"].apply(
    lambda x: len(set(x.split())) / len(x.split()) if len(x.split()) > 0 else 1.0
)

# Add punctuation frequency features
for punct, col_name in [
    ("!", "exclamation_count"),
    ("?", "question_count"),
    (":", "colon_count"),
    (";", "semicolon_count"),
    (",", "comma_count"),
]:
    train_fold[col_name] = train_fold["text"].apply(lambda x: x.lower().count(punct))
    val_fold[col_name] = val_fold["text"].apply(lambda x: x.lower().count(punct))
    test[col_name] = test["text"].apply(lambda x: x.lower().count(punct))

# Normalize punctuation counts by character length
for col in [
    "exclamation_count",
    "question_count",
    "colon_count",
    "semicolon_count",
    "comma_count",
]:
    train_fold[col] = train_fold.apply(
        lambda row: (
            row[col] / row["char_count"]
            if row["char_count"] > 0
            else row[col] / train_fold["char_count"].mean()
        ),
        axis=1,
    )
    val_fold[col] = val_fold.apply(
        lambda row: (
            row[col] / row["char_count"]
            if row["char_count"] > 0
            else row[col] / val_fold["char_count"].mean()
        ),
        axis=1,
    )
    test[col] = test.apply(
        lambda row: (
            row[col] / row["char_count"]
            if row["char_count"] > 0
            else row[col] / test["char_count"].mean()
        ),
        axis=1,
    )


# Add capitalization ratio feature
def extract_cap_feature(text):
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) == 0:
        return 0.0
    upper_count = sum(1 for w in words if w[0].isupper() and w.isalpha())
    alpha_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.isalpha())
    return upper_count / alpha_count if alpha_count > 0 else 0.0


train_fold["cap_ratio"] = train_fold["text"].apply(extract_cap_feature)
val_fold["cap_ratio"] = val_fold["text"].apply(extract_cap_feature)
test["cap_ratio"] = test["text"].apply(extract_cap_feature)

# Add function word frequency ratio features
function_words = [
    "the",
    "a",
    "an",
    "to",
    "of",
    "and",
    "in",
    "is",
    "it",
    "for",
    "that",
    "this",
    "with",
    "as",
    "on",
    "at",
    "by",
    "from",
    "up",
    "but",
    "not",
    "you",
    "he",
    "she",
    "or",
    "be",
    "are",
    "was",
    "when",
    "there",
    "my",
    "have",
    "which",
    "one",
    "his",
    "her",
    "its",
    "me",
    "them",
    "him",
    "we",
    "they",
    "how",
    "who",
    "what",
    "so",
    "can",
    "now",
    "all",
    "any",
    "each",
    "both",
    "our",
    "their",
    "been",
    "being",
    "has",
    "had",
    "does",
    "doing",
    "done",
    "going",
    "will",
    "would",
    "should",
]


def extract_function_word_ratios(text, fw_list):
    tokens = text.lower().split()
    tokens = [t for t in tokens if t.isalpha() and t not in fw_list]
    if len(tokens) == 0 or len(fw_list) == 0:
        return [1.0] * len(fw_list)
    fw_count = {}
    for w in fw_list:
        fw_count[w] = tokens.count(w)
    total_fws = sum(fw_count.values())
    if total_fws == 0:
        return [1.0] * len(fw_list)
    ratios = []
    for w in fw_list:
        ratios.append(fw_count[w] / total_fws)
    return ratios


fw_ratios_train = np.array(
    [extract_function_word_ratios(x, function_words) for x in train_fold["text"]],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
fw_ratios_val = np.array(
    [extract_function_word_ratios(x, function_words) for x in val_fold["text"]],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
fw_ratios_test = np.array(
    [extract_function_word_ratios(x, function_words) for x in test["text"]],
    dtype=np.float64,
)

# Combine numeric features
length_vocab_punct_train = np.column_stack(
    [
        train_fold["char_count"].values,
        train_fold["word_count"].values,
        train_fold["vocab_diversity"].values,
        train_fold["exclamation_count"].values,
        train_fold["question_count"].values,
        train_fold["colon_count"].values,
        train_fold["semicolon_count"].values,
        train_fold["comma_count"].values,
        train_fold["cap_ratio"].values,
    ]
)

length_vocab_punct_val = np.column_stack(
    [
        val_fold["char_count"].values,
        val_fold["word_count"].values,
        val_fold["vocab_diversity"].values,
        val_fold["exclamation_count"].values,
        val_fold["question_count"].values,
        val_fold["colon_count"].values,
        val_fold["semicolon_count"].values,
        val_fold["comma_count"].values,
        val_fold["cap_ratio"].values,
    ]
)

length_vocab_punct_test = np.column_stack(
    [
        test["char_count"].values,
        test["word_count"].values,
        test["vocab_diversity"].values,
        test["exclamation_count"].values,
        test["question_count"].values,
        test["colon_count"].values,
        test["semicolon_count"].values,
        test["comma_count"].values,
        test["cap_ratio"].values,
    ]
)

# Fit scaler on training data only
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaler.fit(length_vocab_punct_train)
length_vocab_punct_train_scaled = scaler.transform(length_vocab_punct_train)
length_vocab_punct_val_scaled = scaler.transform(length_vocab_punct_val)
length_vocab_punct_test_scaled = scaler.transform(length_vocab_punct_test)

# FIX: Shift scaled numeric features to be non-negative before concatenation
# This is required because MultinomialNB only accepts non-negative input features
numeric_min_shift = -length_vocab_punct_train_scaled.min() + 1e-10
length_vocab_punct_train_scaled_shifted = (
    length_vocab_punct_train_scaled + numeric_min_shift
)
length_vocab_punct_val_scaled_shifted = (
    length_vocab_punct_val_scaled + numeric_min_shift
)
length_vocab_punct_test_scaled_shifted = (
    length_vocab_punct_test_scaled + numeric_min_shift
)

# Combine all features for all models
X_train_full = np.hstack(
    [X_train_tfidf, length_vocab_punct_train_scaled_shifted, fw_ratios_train]
)
X_val_full = np.hstack(
    [X_val_tfidf, length_vocab_punct_val_scaled_shifted, fw_ratios_val]
)
X_test_full = np.hstack(
    [X_test_tfidf, length_vocab_punct_test_scaled_shifted, fw_ratios_test]
)

# Verify all features are non-negative
print(f"Min value in training features: {X_train_full.min():.6f}")
assert X_train_full.min() >= -1e-9, "Negative values detected in training features!"

# Define the class labels
author_classes = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
author_to_idx = {cls: i for i, cls in enumerate(author_classes)}
idx_to_class = {i: cls for i, cls in enumerate(author_classes)}

# Base classifiers - using CalibratedClassifierCV for LinearSVC to get probabilities
clf_svm = CalibratedClassifierCV(
    LinearSVC(C=10.0, dual=False, max_iter=5000, random_state=42),
    method="sigmoid",
    cv=5,
)
# Use calibrated Logistic Regression for probability calibration
clf_logreg = CalibratedClassifierCV(
    LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0, max_iter=5000, multi_class="multinomial", random_state=42
    ),
    method="sigmoid",
    cv=5,
)
clf_nb = MultinomialNB(alpha=1.0)

# MLP with improved architecture
clf_mlp = MLPClassifier(
    hidden_layer_sizes=(256, 128, 64),
    activation="relu",
    solver="adam",
    max_iter=1000,
    random_state=42,
    early_stopping=True,
    validation_fraction=0.15,
    n_iter_no_change=20,
    learning_rate="adaptive",
    learning_rate_init=0.001,
    momentum=0.9,
)

# Train base classifiers on training fold only (not including validation data)
print("Training SVM...")
clf_svm.fit(X_train_full, train_fold["author"])
print("Training Logistic Regression (with Platt scaling calibration)...")
clf_logreg.fit(X_train_full, train_fold["author"])
print("Training Naive Bayes...")
clf_nb.fit(X_train_full, train_fold["author"])
print("Training MLP...")
clf_mlp.fit(X_train_full, train_fold["author"])

# Get prediction probabilities for validation (from models trained ONLY on training fold)
val_svm_proba = clf_svm.predict_proba(X_val_full)
val_logreg_proba = clf_logreg.predict_proba(X_val_full)
val_nb_proba = clf_nb.predict_proba(X_val_full)
val_mlp_proba = clf_mlp.predict_proba(X_val_full)

# Evaluate individual model performance
eps = 1e-15
y_val_onehot = np.zeros((len(val_fold), len(author_classes)))
for i, author in enumerate(val_fold["author"]):
    y_val_onehot[i, author_to_idx[author]] = 1


def compute_log_loss(proba, y_true):
    proba_clipped = np.clip(proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    N = len(y_true)
    return -np.mean(y_true * np.log(proba_clipped))


svm_val_loss = compute_log_loss(val_svm_proba, y_val_onehot)
logreg_val_loss = compute_log_loss(val_logreg_proba, y_val_onehot)
nb_val_loss = compute_log_loss(val_nb_proba, y_val_onehot)
mlp_val_loss = compute_log_loss(val_mlp_proba, y_val_onehot)

print(f"SVM validation log loss: {svm_val_loss:.6f}")
print(f"LogReg (platt scaled) validation log loss: {logreg_val_loss:.6f}")
print(f"NB validation log loss: {nb_val_loss:.6f}")
print(f"MLP validation log loss: {mlp_val_loss:.6f}")

# Compute weights based on validation performance
weights = []
for name, loss in [
    ("SVM", svm_val_loss),
    ("LogReg", logreg_val_loss),
    ("NB", nb_val_loss),
    ("MLP", mlp_val_loss),
]:
    w = 1 / (loss + 1e-10)
    weights.append((name, w))

total_weight = sum(w for _, w in weights)
model_weights = {name: w / total_weight for name, w in weights}

print(f"Ensemble Weights: {model_weights}")

# Weighted ensemble for validation
val_svm_proba_clipped = np.clip(val_svm_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
val_logreg_proba_clipped = np.clip(val_logreg_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
val_nb_proba_clipped = np.clip(val_nb_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
val_mlp_proba_clipped = np.clip(val_mlp_proba, eps, 1 - eps)

val_proba = (
    model_weights["SVM"] * val_svm_proba_clipped
    + model_weights["LogReg"] * val_logreg_proba_clipped
    + model_weights["NB"] * val_nb_proba_clipped
    + model_weights["MLP"] * val_mlp_proba_clipped
)

# Calculate multi-class log loss on hold-out validation set
log_loss_val = compute_log_loss(val_proba, y_val_onehot)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss (hold-out): {log_loss_val:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set (using models trained ONLY on training fold)
test_svm_proba = clf_svm.predict_proba(X_test_full)
test_logreg_proba = clf_logreg.predict_proba(X_test_full)
test_nb_proba = clf_nb.predict_proba(X_test_full)
test_mlp_proba = clf_mlp.predict_proba(X_test_full)

test_svm_proba_clipped = np.clip(test_svm_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
test_logreg_proba_clipped = np.clip(test_logreg_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
test_nb_proba_clipped = np.clip(test_nb_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
test_mlp_proba_clipped = np.clip(test_mlp_proba, eps, 1 - eps)

test_proba = (
    model_weights["SVM"] * test_svm_proba_clipped
    + model_weights["LogReg"] * test_logreg_proba_clipped
    + model_weights["NB"] * test_nb_proba_clipped
    + model_weights["MLP"] * test_mlp_proba_clipped
)

# Create submission file with correct format
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"]})
for i, cls in enumerate(author_classes):
    submission[cls] = test_proba[:, i]

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Test set rows: {len(test)}")

end_time = time.time()
print(f"Total execution time: {end_time - start_time:.1f} seconds")
